contract: Task list/create/creation recovery/PATCH/detail GET include updatedAt.

Modern PATCH includes canonical ISO expectedUpdatedAt in JSON; version-only payload rejected. Modern DELETE specifies expectedUpdatedAt query parameter; malformed or repeated version rejected before transaction.
Actor SHARE then task UPDATE lock, fresh row version comparison, explicit monotonic updatedAt increment; conflicting modern writes return 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.
Detail GET takes actor and task SHARE locks and returns found/current task or missing/null. Missing is absence, never proof that this actor deleted it. No write/replay in recovery.
